candidates.evidence: ADR-0178's Amendment (ratified 2026-08-13, utterance comment 5275019730 on GH #696; built as PR #826, tracker #821 closed): the AUTHORSHIP-SCOPED RE-RULING pattern — a uniform append-only protection re-scoped along the authorship axis rather than removed wholesale: host-seeded builtin prompt sections become model-updatable IN PLACE (updateTargetIndex as the whole fence, kind-derived never literal; two-field scope pinned) while user-authored entries stay append-protected and deletion stays impossible everywhere. builtin:true = NON-DELETABLE ONLY (ADR-0132 Fork 4), never immutable — the amendment exploits that distinction. Checked 2026-08-13 (decision-watcher-sweep, sweep-6): neither admin-library-kinds nor composition-patterns carries a row for this shape.

candidates.evidence: ADR-0192 (ratified 2026-08-16, GH #955/#956/#957): the THIRD proof of the 'mint a new zero-dep sibling package off components' architecture pattern (router ADR-0115 -> code ADR-0119 -> data ADR-0192) — when general-purpose functionality doesn't fit components' reactive<-dom<-traits<-controls layering and would ride every consumer's foundation budget (ADR-0040), the answer is a new sibling package (shared <- components <- {router,code,data}), catalog-invisible by construction (a2ui never imports it), never grown inside components itself.
